testCases.input: Verify activity type to meta-template mapping
Verify all lifecycle operations use MCP tools

setup: 1. Ensure OpenCode is initialized with default config
2. Ensure TemplateLibrary.initialize() has been called to load bootstrap templates
interpretation: PASS: All 5 test cases return pass: true
FAIL: Any test case returns pass: false (check actual vs expected)
Each test verifies a critical aspect of the lifecycle automation implementation

validationStrategy.rationale: Full end-to-end testing would require running activities, triggering failures, waiting for boredom idle detection, etc. This harness focuses on verifying the infrastructure is in place: config schema exists, template mapping logic is correct, bootstrap templates are available, and MCP abstraction is maintained.
limitations: Does not test actual activity execution and failure
Does not test boredom system activation (requires 5min idle)
Does not test actual debug-activity triggering (requires real failure)
Does not intercept HTTP calls to verify no direct API usage
futureEnhancements: Add integration test that creates failing activity and verifies auto-debug
Add integration test that simulates boredom activity and verifies template evolution
Add network monitoring to verify no direct HTTP calls
Add threshold testing (verify debug only triggers after N failures)

validationResults.expectedBehavior: All 5 tests should PASS if lifecycle automation is correctly implemented
criticalTests: case-2: Lifecycle Automation Config (verifies new config schema)
case-3: Boredom Template Mapping (verifies P0 fix for template mapping)
nonCriticalTests: case-1: Template Auto-Registration (already working before this activity)
case-5: MCP Abstraction (static check, always passes)
